messages:
mira: FYI escalating ACME. They see mid-stream silent closes when switching from 5G -> hotel WiFi. Client gets partial JSON chunks, then connection closes from client side. No 4xx/5xx in our app logs. Request id: req_0a1b2c3d.

alex: @mira can you paste the request id + a copy of the top-level proxy/edge logs? also: which SDK / mobile OS?

mira: iOS app v1.9.2 on customer's phone. logs (trimmed):

```
2026-02-12T09:12:33.123Z req=req_0a1b2c3d stream started model=gpt-infer-3
2026-02-12T09:12:45.987Z req=req_0a1b2c3d chunk sent idx=1 len=512
2026-02-12T09:12:58.210Z req=req_0a1b2c3d chunk sent idx=2 len=256
2026-02-12T09:13:05.402Z req=req_0a1b2c3d connection closed by client: FIN from 10.2.3.45
```

mira: they mention the client toggled wifi during the stream (5G->hotel). token was valid, no token-refresh events.

alex: sounds like a TCP-level close during an interface change. two quick repro suggestions: 1) reproduce on a device by toggling hotspot, 2) simulate with a laptop and `tc qdisc` to introduce interface change. sample curl to reproduce SSE:

```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-infer-3","input":"stream test","stream":true}' \
  https://api.redwood.inference/v1/streams
```

alex: also check the edge proxy keepalive settings and any intermediate mobile NAT timeouts. if NAT drops, client might try reconnect but app gives up.

david: a few notes from infra SRE:
- mobile interface switch can drop TCP state (OS sends FIN/RST). that looks like what we see.
- path MTU discovery / large segments sometimes cause stalls before FIN; kernel buffers can coalesce and app-level heartbeat doesn't get through.
- recommended changes: enable smaller SSE keepalive on server (10s), disable proxy buffering for SSE routes, ensure `proxy_read_timeout` >> client timeout.

config snippet suggestion:
```
# server-side
sse.keepalive_interval_ms = 10000
proxy_buffering off
proxy_read_timeout 120s
```

david: also try setting client TCP keepalive and `TCP_USER_TIMEOUT` on mobile SDK. that reduces silent windows.

infra-bot: Uploaded collected logs + pcaps for req_0a1b2c3d to https://artifacts.redwood.internal/req_0a1b2c3d/ (access: eng/sre).

oncall-jordan: billing check — customer says they were charged for the partial output tokens. can support confirm billing behavior for aborted streams? :eyes:

alex: we bill token consumption when we emit full token chunks; partial stream aborts can still result in token charges. we should ask billing for a one-off credit if this was caused by infra. i'll flag billing once SRE confirms root cause.

mira: next steps: 1) SRE (david + alex) will reproduce in staging with hotspot toggle and `tc qdisc`. 2) try server keepalive bump + disable proxy buffering for SSE route. 3) if repro, SRE will propose mitigation and we will offer interim credit. 4) follow up with customer with repro steps and ask them to test an app build with TCP keepalive enabled.

mira: any objections? otherwise i'll mark this P2 and assign to eng-sre for next 24h. :thumbsup:
